message.content:
Sure! Just split on the first `=` only:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split at most once
print(parts)                # ['hello', 'good=']
```

Using `split('=', 1)` ensures you get exactly two elements: `"hello"` and `"good="`.
